title: ROS1 Hardware Smoke Test Artifact
description: Records the result of a FireClaw ROS1 hardware smoke test run. Explicitly excludes robot IP addresses, credentials, and site-specific paths.

robot_id.description: Identifier of the robot under test. Must match the robot_id in the ROS1 adapter config.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the smoke test was performed.

overall_passed.description: True if every test in the run passed.

operator_notes.description: Free-text notes from the operator. Must not contain robot IPs, credentials, or site-specific paths.

endpoint_name.description: ROS topic, service, or action name as it appears on the ROS network (e.g. '/fireclaw/firebot_01/navigate').

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the test in milliseconds.

error.description: Error message if the test failed. Omit or null if passed.

notes.description: Free-text notes for this test. Must not contain robot IPs, credentials, or site-specific paths.
